user_reported_bug: Photo albums still not loading fast. My 4-Year Anniversary album has over 190 photos. If Lightox is not giving me my request, please try something else.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused verification passed for the large-photo-album performance fix: API pagination/count returned correct 190-photo slices, generated thumbnails persisted to object storage and returned X-Thumb-Cache: STORAGE after backend restart, and the Photos UI initially rendered only 60 tiles then appended the next 60 via scroll-triggered infinite loading. Lightbox prev/next and a <60-photo album edge case also passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Inspected /app/backend/routes/photos.py, /app/backend/server.py, and /app/frontend/src/pages/Photos.jsx. The implemented limit/offset guardrails, count endpoint, persistent thumbnail STORAGE path, PAGE_SIZE=60, and IntersectionObserver sentinel match the reported performance contract.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA albums (190-photo large album and 3-photo small album) backed by one real uploaded JPEG object; verified through API/UI; cleaned up 193 photo docs and both temporary albums afterward.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend script output: count total=190; pages offset 0/60/120/180 returned 60/60/60/10 with no overlap; guard requests limit=99999, offset=-3, and limit=-2 all returned 200; thumbnail first response MISS and after supervisor backend restart returned X-Thumb-Cache: STORAGE. UI MCP output: initial 60 tiles with Showing 60 of 190 + Load more; scroll updated to Showing 120 of 190; lightbox next/prev worked; small album showed Showing 3 of 3 with no load-more/loading state. Preview console only showed expected pre-login auth 401s and non-photo OneSignal preview-domain warnings.
rca_of_the_issue: Original slowness was addressed by limiting initial photo fetch/render to 60 records and persisting generated thumbnails to object storage so post-restart/cold visits avoid repeated Pillow work. Verification used a seeded 190-photo album to reproduce the large-album path end to end. No mocked APIs were used.
